skill.name: stock-analysis
skill.description: Analyze stocks and companies using financial market data. Get company profiles, technical insights, price charts, insider holdings, and SEC filings for comprehensive stock research.
skill.userDescription: Analyze stocks and public companies using market data, price charts, ownership information, and SEC filings.
exampleQuestions: Can you analyze Apple's recent stock performance and market trends?
Retrieve the latest SEC filings and ownership details for Tesla.
Provide a comprehensive financial breakdown and price chart analysis for Microsoft.
